manuscript_title: CoordRep: A Canonical, Continuous, and Compositional Representation for Coordination Chemistry
purpose: Publication-facing implementation, current Figure 1-6 and Supplementary Figure S1-S2 evidence, and release-wide April 2025 CSD audit aggregates

canonicalization.implementation_change: Source-index-free ligand attachment-set and donor-specific attachment keys, attachment-aware serialized payloads, exact legal residual-orbit enumeration, minimum-whole-record selection, and fail-closed handling of unresolved repeated-payload exchangeability

general_invariance.trials: 100 variants in each of proper-rigid-motion, atom-reindexing, and combined arms

legal_orbit_challenge.screen: 5173 challenge-eligible graphs among 6427 eligible unique graphs
legal_orbit_challenge.full_exact_result: 100000/100000 exact matches; 1000/1000 fully collapsed; zero errors

canonicalization.compatibility_boundary: Attachment-aware payloads can change canonical strings, token sequences, and molecular L0-L3 hashes relative to rc2. Figure 2 and Supplementary Figure S2 are rc3 evidence. Figure 4 and the molecular-family benchmark in Figure 6 remain frozen rc2 downstream evidence and were not rerun under rc3.

continuous_shape_measure.method: Proper-rotation coordinate-space CShM with central assignment fixed and exhaustive donor-template assignment for supported CN2-CN6 references
continuous_shape_measure.legacy_boundary: Legacy donor-distance-matrix scores are forensic controls and are not CShM.

full_csd_audit.runtime: Python 3.10.19; CCDC Python API 3.6.0; NumPy 2.2.6; SciPy 1.13.1
full_csd_audit.target_definition: has_3d_structure and at least one atom in the frozen in-domain set Sc-Zn, Y-Cd, La, and Hf-Hg
full_csd_audit.scope_boundary: Predefined 3D d-block target corpus; not all metal-containing CSD entries. Other lanthanides, actinides, and main-group-only entries are outside the denominator, while mixed-metal external relations are retained.

redistribution.included: Code, protocols, aggregate/public source tables, artwork, synchronized Supporting Information, small synthetic controls, and cryptographic commitments
redistribution.excluded: Raw CSD coordinates, raw CSD structure files, and licensed row-level CSD ledgers
